entities.summary: Kataja is an islet south of Haparanda in Norrbotten. It is the easternmost point of Sweden and it is part of the Haparanda archipelago. The islet has an area of 71 hectares. It is about 2 kilometres (1.2 mi) long and 200 to 500 metres wide.
